## unix.file

**Recorded native contract:** Authored selectors are filepath/path/filename; collected fields are full_path/directory/name. Null filename is the directory form. File traversal is explicit and downward; depth 0 includes the starting directory; unlimited is a string token, not null or -1. Native semantic rules retain older collected-field naming.

[Tracking issue](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/issues/33); native adoption and runtime qualification remain pending.

**Legacy observations, not normative:** OVAL file Items include link types, integer epoch-second timestamps, size, UID/GID and mode bits. FileBehaviors distinguishes recursion and filesystem restriction. ACL unsupported is described as an absent entity, not false.

Native sources: [unix.file.json](../../schema/capability-mappings/supported/unix.file.json#/native), [unix.file.json](../../schema/capability-mappings/supported/unix.file.json#/semantic_validator_rules), [capability-common.schema.json](../../schema/capability-common.schema.json#/$defs/file_traversal_base), [capability-common.schema.json](../../schema/capability-common.schema.json#/$defs/file_traversal), [capability-common.schema.json](../../schema/capability-common.schema.json#/$defs/filesystem_scope).

### unix-boundaries

**Gap:** all/local/same exist, but mount identity, unknown filesystem classification, symlink cycles and races need a complete collection contract.

**Recommendation:** Recommend same remain within the starting filesystem identity; distinguish that from a mount-instance boundary. Classify local using target filesystem evidence; uncertain classification yields incomplete evidence rather than guessing. Traverse links only under the explicit recurse policy, prevent ancestor cycles and retain distinct selected path aliases.

**Compatibility:** Bind mounts can share filesystem identity. Switching to a mount-ID boundary is a different contract. Source defined-to-same conversion alone does not prove equivalence.

Alternatives: Filesystem identity boundary (recommended for same). Mount-instance boundary; stricter and may omit source-selected paths.

### unix-links

**Gap:** Link-object metadata versus target metadata is not fully specified, including dangling links and directory links selected by filepath.

**Recommendation:** Recommend link-object metadata for direct selection, preserving dangling-link existence; following a target is a separate explicit traversal action. Keep directory selection through path plus null filename. Record cycles, target failures and disappearing paths without silently replacing one identity by another.

**Compatibility:** Existing stat-versus-link-stat collector choices may disagree; require independent platform vectors before adopting this recommendation.

### unix-metadata

**Gap:** Integer timestamps lack explicit native epoch/resolution; permissions and ACL unavailable states are incompletely documented.

**Recommendation:** Recommend UTC epoch seconds for access/change/modify times, with change meaning inode metadata change, not creation. Preserve mode bits and numeric ownership independently of effective access or ACL grants. Extra ACL false means supported with no extra ACL; recommend not_collected plus diagnostic when unsupported, never false. Preserve more precise raw timestamps in provenance if collected, without inventing native units.

**Compatibility:** Time resolution and ACL unsupported-status choices can change comparisons. OVAL uses does-not-exist for unsupported ACL; the proposed not-collected status is deliberately an owner decision.

Alternatives: Unsupported ACL as not_collected with diagnostic (recommended). Legacy-style does_not_exist entity; changes absence predicates differently.

### unix-errors

**Gap:** Missing, inaccessible, partially traversed and changed files lack a complete native outcome table.

**Recommendation:** Use zero selected Items only for complete confirmed absence. Parent-directory denial, lost permissions or incomplete traversal retain diagnostics and completeness; they cannot satisfy none-found by omission. Preserve independent readable metadata if later fields fail.

**Compatibility:** Permission bits are not effective access tests. Synthetic does-not-exist Items remain forbidden by the existing native Item schema.

### Proposed regression expectations

Each row references the research example; explicit input flags or selectors identify a variant. `unresolved` means a contract-dependent scenario or different requirement must be selected before an executable native outcome can be asserted. Full input fixtures are in the [vector ledger](../metadata/developer-guide-semantic-vectors.json).

| Vector | Proposed outcome | Expected evidence / assumption |
| --- | --- | --- |
| unix-positive | true | Existing fixture file is owned by root in the controlled evidence. |
| unix-negative | false | Do not resolve UID through a name or effective-access test. |
| unix-missing | false | No synthetic missing Item; one-or-more population fails. |
| unix-permission-denied | error | Denied lookup is not complete absence. |
| unix-race | error | Preserve readable independent fields and incomplete diagnostic. |
| unix-dangling-link | true | Recommended direct link-object metadata preserves link existence, not target absence. |
| unix-link-owner-conflict | false | Recommended direct selection compares link ownership; target substitution would change the result. |
| unix-link-cycle | unresolved | Terminate cyclic descent and report completeness according to a reviewed traversal contract; never hang. |
| unix-depth-zero | unresolved | Starting directory only; uses a traversal variant, not the full-path example. |
| unix-depth-one | unresolved | Include first descendant depth, exclude deeper a/b; variant requires explicit path/filename selectors. |
| unix-bind-same-filesystem | unresolved | Recommended filesystem identity boundary differs from a mount-instance boundary. |
| unix-local-unknown | error | Proposed incomplete classification diagnostic; do not guess local. |
| unix-duplicate-path-aliases | unresolved | Keep distinct selected path identities; use ancestor identity for cycle prevention, not global path deduplication. |
| unix-acl-none | unresolved | Recommended has_extended_acl=false; this vector requires an ACL-specific variant of the Assessment. |
| unix-acl-unsupported | unresolved | Recommend not_collected with diagnostic; source OVAL absent-entity behavior is an explicit alternative. |
| unix-mode-versus-effective | unresolved | Mode-bit fields describe permission bits, not effective access. |
| unix-time-resolution | unresolved | Proposed native integer seconds plus separate raw provenance; no unapproved timestamp conversion. |
| unix-absence-confirmed | true | Explicit absence variant: complete confirmed empty population satisfies none-found. |
| unix-absence-denied | error | Absence variant must not become true when selection was denied. |
| unix-multiple-conflicting | false | Preserve both selected Items; every-item satisfaction cannot become one-or-more. |
